org.apache.juneau.rest.server.console.data.SeriesSource

Packages that use SeriesSource
Package
Description
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.console.data
Server helpers for console data sources: SeriesSource streams rows as CSV or NDJSON, and SeriesAggregator answers the aggregate request a data source sends when its result is too large to load raw.
